question: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a straight line, facing north. S is an immediate neighbour of both P and R. R is an immediate neighbour of both S and Q. Q is an immediate neighbour of both R and T. Who are the immediate neighbours of Q?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) S is an immediate neighbour of both P and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a101f65934f7ee51eb2f3d0203a6bebc44175ac1936e2079b65685acb3671b89.png] 

2) R is an immediate neighbour of both S and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/833b269f736f1eb5a990150593122008cc31326a928f69eeb97445cd29bda6fe.png] 

3) Q is an immediate neighbour of both R and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7ca57bb65ea114fbdd6a28527cfc5135bcf138a717238da0ef76bb6270f2aa9.png] 

So, '**R and T**' are the immediate neighbours of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
